_about: Edge cases a good test list for each ticket must contain, graded by `npm run eval:edges` against whatever testcases.json each ticket's run holds now. A judge model decides, per edge, which case (if any) exercises it; an edge no case exercises is a missing edge case. Edges marked `source: bug` are real defects found in that run by verify or review, so a list without them provably let a bug through; `source: ticket` edges come from the ticket's own scope. Re-run the testcases phase on a ticket after a prompt change, then run the eval, to see whether the change made the lists weaker. `projects` groups tickets by the GitLab project their iids belong to, since an iid means nothing without its project; add another repo as a sibling key.
